title: Motion guide path following: guided layer tween
description: When a layer has type='guided' and there is an adjacent 'guide' layer containing a path, motion tweens on the guided layer should follow that path. In the renderer (renderer.ts renderFrame): if a SymbolInstance is on a guided layer with an active motion tween, sample the guide path at ratio t=frame/totalFrames using quadratic bezier t-parameter and set the instance's position to that point. If motionOrientToPath=true, also rotate the instance to the tangent angle. In compile.ts: generate PlaceObject2 records with the path-sampled positions (bake the path into per-frame transforms). Add 4 unit tests. See docs/06-tweens-and-animation.md.
